reason: Fresh available memory decreased on two six-E/two-I hosts. Tighten finite worker caps according to local useful work; preserve 64 GiB reserve, zero swap, all numerical/output gates and timeouts. No formal 0.8% simulation was launched under the original admission policy.

Endpoint seven-E/one-I known arrays 638.726 GiB imply ~653.08 GiB; six-E/two-I has ~3.37 GiB less edge storage. Caps retain ~5-7 GiB above these illustrative estimates.
